lucas: Quick blocker on docs PR #530 — the migration guide currently says "model pinning is deployment-scoped" but the example shows a per-route pin. Can runtime confirm precedence so we don't mislead customers?
anya: good catch. Precedence is: route-level pin > deployment-level pin > global default. We should be explicit.
lucas: here's the example I added:
```
routes:
  - name: ai-help
    model: assistant:stable
    pin: true
```

lucas: PR text currently: "Pinning applies at deployment scope." Should we change to mention route overrides?
pratik: yes, change it. Also note: in Dedicated/Private, deployment admins can set a disallow-route-pins flag which prevents route-level overrides for tenancy reasons. So add a short sentence about admin controls.
anya: suggested replacement: "Model pins can be set at global, deployment, or route scope. The router applies pins in order of route -> deployment -> global. Note: deployment admins may disable route-level pinning for Dedicated/Private deployments."
lucas: perfect. Also, any interaction with automated rollouts? I mention rollout policies in the guide.
pratik: rollout respects the active pin: if a route is pinned, rollouts won't change that route's model until pin removed. Add one line.
ci-bot: preview available for PR #530 1 https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/530 (status: success) :white_check_mark:
lucas: thanks. @docs-bot add label "merge-on-runtime-ack" please.
docs-bot: label "merge-on-runtime-ack" added by docs-bot.
anya: once wording is updated and you include a tiny SDK snippet showing how to set a route pin via the API, I'll approve.
lucas: adding SDK snippet now and will push. PTAL after push.
pratik: LGTM from runtime side after the edit.
anya: approved, will merge in the afternoon merge window.
